title: AI Adoption's Impact on Employment of Fresh Graduates
what_it_is: AI Adoption's Impact on Employment of Fresh Graduates

sections.label: AI impact on PMET jobs
sections.summary: IHLs work with sector agencies and industry partners to keep curriculum relevant for the AI era, complemented by work-based learning like the AI Apprenticeship Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: While artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping the labour market, its specific impact on entry-level professionals, managers, executives and technicians (PMETs) jobs remains uncertain.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To prepare graduates for the AI era, IHLs are working closely with sector agencies and industry partners to keep their curriculum relevant, integrating AI competencies, domain-specific training and core skills, like critical thinking, creativity and communication.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: These efforts are complemented by work-based learning programmes, such as the AI Apprenticeship Programme, which provide opportunities to apply AI skills in real workplace settings.

sections.label: GRIT Programme for graduates
sections.summary: In view of heightened economic uncertainties in 2025, the Government introduced the GRIT Programme to help young graduates gain industry-relevant experience and move to permanent employment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In view of the heightened economic uncertainties in 2025, the Government introduced the GRaduate Industry Traineeships (GRIT) Programme to support young graduates to obtain industry-relevant experience and facilitate their transition to permanent employment.

sections.label: WSG job transformation and reskilling
sections.summary: WSG's Jobs Transformation Maps guide employers and workers on AI reshaping roles, while the AI Apprenticeship Programme and reskilling programmes like TeSA and Career Conversion Programmes provide support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: For example, WSG's Jobs Transformation Maps, which help guide employers and workers on how AI actually reshape roles and some of the required skills, enabling early job redesign rather than elimination of positions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: There are other things that we are doing as well, in terms of strengthening entry level opportunities, for example, the AI Apprenticeship Programme, under the AI Strategy 2.0, which helps build a pipeline of young AI practitioners through on-the-job training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: The second one is also providing more support for reskilling, for example, the Infocomm Media Development Authority's Tech Skills Accelerator programme, as well as some of WSG's Career Conversion Programmes.
